title: Seasonal Signal Cartographer
tagline: Spend eight expeditions uncovering wildlife signals across a shifting seasonal map.

paper.title: ISBO: Scalable Spatio-Temporal Bayesian Optimization with Log Gaussian Cox Process Models via the INLA-SPDE Approach

novelty: A seasonal fog-of-war map game fuses point-event exploration with a scarce expedition budget and seeded random scout; no known implementation of this game (not verified).
description: Explore a synthetic seasonal wildlife map, reveal event sightings, and use a clearly labeled heuristic cue to choose the next patch.
howItWorks: The demo independently generates deterministic synthetic event dots for each patch and season, keeps sightings visible across seasons, and draws an illustrative kernel-smoothed intensity and heuristic masked recommendation. A seeded random scout explores with the same budget. It does not implement the paper's inference method.
controls: Tap or click an open patch on Your map to spend an expedition; choose a season to reveal that season's field, edit the world seed, or reset. The golden outline marks a heuristic suggestion.
